2608.04761.title: InsightEmb: Learning Action-Intent Embeddings for Agentic Insight Retrieval
2608.04761.paper_summary: Self-improving agents accumulate reusable insights from prior trajectories, making retrieval increasingly important for turning accumulated experience into actionable guidance. At each decision step, retrieving the right insight can help the agent progress toward its goal, a setting we refer to as agentic insight retrieval. However, existing retrieval methods primarily model semantic similarity, while overlooking whether a retrieved insight resolves the agent's current decision bottleneck. We propose InsightEmb, a contrastive embedding framework that learns transferable progress-oriented retrieval geometry using only mathematical reasoning data. InsightEmb jointly learns to align concrete situations with abstract heuristic rules and to cluster reasoning trajectories with similar progress structures. We evaluate InsightEmb on dynamic agent tasks and a static skill-retrieval benchmark. Without any environment-specific training, InsightEmb improves over all these evaluations, surpassing the performance of existing reasoning embedding models. These results suggest that the geometry of state-insight matching can transfer across domains, enabling effective training from publicly available reasoning data without expensive environment-specific supervision.
2608.04761.paper_summary_zh: 自我提升的代理從先前的軌跡中積累可重用的見解，使得檢索在將積累的經驗轉化為可行指導方面越來越重要。<lb/>在每個決策步驟中，檢索正確的見解可以幫助代理朝著其目標前進，我們稱之為代理見解檢索。<lb/>然而，現有的檢索方法主要建模語義相似性，而忽略了檢索到的見解是否能解決代理當前的決策瓶頸。<lb/>我們提出了InsightEmb，一種對比嵌入框架，僅使用數學推理數據學習可轉移的進步導向檢索幾何。<lb/>InsightEmb共同學習將具體情境與抽象啟發式規則對齊，並將具有相似進步結構的推理軌跡進行聚類。<lb/>我們在動態代理任務和靜態技能檢索基準上評估了InsightEmb。<lb/>在沒有任何特定環境訓練的情況下，InsightEmb在所有這些評估中都有所改善，超越了現有推理嵌入模型的表現。<lb/>這些結果表明，狀態-見解匹配的幾何可以跨領域轉移，使得能夠從公開可用的推理數據中進行有效訓練，而無需昂貴的特定環境監督。
